faqs.question: How quickly can you deliver?
faqs.answer: We deliver within 30-60 minutes across most Dubai areas. Marina, JLT, JBR, Downtown, Business Bay usually 30-45 mins. Other areas up to 60 mins.

faqs.question: What's included in the delivery?
faqs.answer: Fully prepared sheesha ready to smoke, natural charcoal, tongs, mouth tips, setup by our driver, and pickup later. You just enjoy!

faqs.question: Do you have a minimum order?
faqs.answer: No minimum, but free delivery for orders above AED 150. Otherwise AED 25 delivery fee.

faqs.question: How long does one sheesha last?
faqs.answer: Classic lasts 3-4 hours, Premium 4-5 hours with charcoal refills included. We provide extra charcoal.

faqs.question: Is it legal and hygienic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we are fully licensed for tobacco delivery in Dubai. All sheeshas are sanitized, with disposable hoses and mouth tips. We follow Dubai Municipality hygiene standards.

faqs.question: Can I order for a yacht or villa party?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in yacht, villa, and event deliveries. Our Party and VIP packages include attendant service.

faqs.question: What payment methods?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery, card on delivery, bank transfer, and coming soon online payment. No advance needed for regular orders.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific time?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can schedule delivery for later today or future date. Just let us know date and time in WhatsApp.

policies.age: Service only for 18+ years. ID may be required on delivery.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 1 hour before delivery time.
policies.hygiene: All equipment sanitized, disposable pipes, COVID-safe handling.
policies.legal: Compliant with UAE tobacco regulations. Delivery only to private residences, hotels, licensed venues.
